description: A career and technical education coordinator must approve a student's work-based learning placement and finalize the hours, supervision, and graduation-record details, with input from the work-based learning teacher and the graduation records specialist.

shared_context.S1: A student needs an approved work-based learning placement to complete a career-readiness requirement this semester.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Bennett makes the final approval and records the placement plan.
shared_context.S3: The current draft selects Eastside Community Center, schedules 60 hours, names a general site mentor, and uses transcript code WBL-LOCAL.
shared_context.S4: Northline Clinic has offered a placement with a named supervisor, but it requires a longer commute than Eastside Community Center.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal approval process, Ms. Bennett reviews the draft with the work-based learning teacher and graduation records specialist before signing it.
shared_context.S6: Transportation and other commute logistics are handled outside this approval process and do not need to be resolved before the placement plan is signed; this review is limited to site suitability, hours, transcript code, and supervisor qualifications.

PF1.text: Mr. Ortiz reviewed Eastside Community Center's proposed duties against the student's health-care pathway this week and confirmed that Eastside cannot provide the required clinical skill observation; Northline Clinic can provide that observation under its licensed nurse supervisor. He has not updated the draft because the site review was completed after the draft circulated.

PF2.text: Ms. Park's graduation audit shows that this student must complete exactly 90 work-based-learning hours for 0.5 credit, and the correct transcript code is WBL-CAREER; she confirmed the audit with the registrar this week but has not changed the draft record.

acceptance_conditions: Northline Clinic must be selected because it can provide the required clinical skill observation.
The placement plan must name a licensed nurse as the qualified supervisor.
The student must be scheduled for exactly 90 work-based-learning hours.
The plan must award exactly 0.5 credit.
The transcript code must be exactly WBL-CAREER.
A placement-supervision verification commitment must be recorded.
A graduation-record correction commitment must be recorded.
The clinical-placement requirement must be cited from the teacher's disclosed fact.

content_checks.C2: decisions['supervisor_qualification'] in ['licensed nurse supervisor', 'Licensed nurse supervisor', 'licensed nurse supervisor (named supervisor)', 'Licensed nurse supervisor (named supervisor)', 'licensed nurse', 'Licensed nurse']
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] in ['Mr. Ortiz', 'A2'] and 'Northline' in c['detail'] and ('supervisor' in c['detail'] or 'licensed nurse' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] in ['Ms. Park', 'A3'] and '90' in c['detail'] and ('WBL-CAREER' in c['detail'] or 'transcript code' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The site review changes the placement from Eastside Community Center to Northline Clinic, changes supervision from a general site mentor to a licensed nurse supervisor, and requires a commitment that names Northline and the qualified supervisor.
The graduation audit changes the required hours from 60 to exactly 90, confirms 0.5 credit, replaces WBL-LOCAL with WBL-CAREER, and requires a commitment documenting those record corrections.
